description: Answers: which place is meant when a name is ambiguous, such as several towns with the same name. The user's favorite locations whose names match come first. Optionally ranks the other results near another place or "here".

near.description: A place name or "here" to rank results near.

query.description: A place name, or part of one.

name: search_places

reason.description: plan, region, source, setting; others may appear.

favorite.description: One of the user's favorite locations (listed first); pass its name as a place to use it.

status.description: ok or subscription_required; others may appear.

title: Search places
